Image 2 design_reference.png is ONLY the approved design, colour and material reference.
Image 3 concept_crop.png is the original concept, a secondary appearance reference.
The two coloured references are three-quarter illustrations; NEVER copy their camera, silhouette or dramatic lighting.

PRIMARY REQUEST:
Paint the materials of the approved design onto the exact grey back-view guide. Bone-white ceramic plates with fine chips and grey grime; polished gold bands, window frames, rivets and valve wheel; deep-blue painted livery stripe; clear glass windows filled with bright saturated red stim fluid, evenly lit from within; small blue-white light in the existing circular fitting. Keep the crisp material separations and restrained fine wear from the approved design. Paint glowing parts at their glowing colour without casting glow onto surrounding parts.

LOCKED GEOMETRY:
Maintain all existing guide geometry and all transparent areas, with no pixels or details added beyond the silhouette, no cropping, no repositioning, no resizing.
Guide bounds are x=303 through 720, y=66 through 957 on the 1024 square canvas.
The top wheel is seen strictly edge-on as the thin horizontal bar already in the guide, around x=389..640, y=66..98; keep its edge-on silhouette, NEVER open it into an elliptical top view.
Retain its narrow central stem and collar. Retain the rounded shoulder, the upper horizontal band and its centered circular/octagonal light bezel exactly where shown. Retain the two long existing rounded rectangular window shapes on the left and right, with the center body strip between them. Preserve the bottom band, side clamps, narrow lower shaft, all gaps and the wide flared base exactly as the guide. Keep the polygonal edges of the actual model. Transfer only surface colour/material artwork; no perspective change, no new openings or protrusions.

LIGHTING IS ALBEDO:
Even, flat, shadowless frontal illumination from the viewer. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no dark side shading, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light, no lighting gradient across the canister. Gold should read through its gold base colour and fine surface variation, not bright white gloss or baked shading. Glass should reveal the saturated red fluid with restrained fluid/bubble colour detail, without white reflection streaks. The red and blue-white elements do not illuminate their surroundings.

OUTPUT:
Exactly ONE image, 1024 x 1024, actual transparent background preserving the guide alpha and holes. No background, no floor, no checkerboard painted into the image, no text, no labels, no borders. Raw full-resolution image suitable for direct projection onto the existing mesh.
